name: UGC university register — universities in Rajshahi Division
attribution: Source: University Grants Commission of Bangladesh (ugc.gov.bd)
notes: All 181 universities on ugc.gov.bd (public, private, international, CBHE) were read from the page data embedded in each university page (/university/<slug>); kept where the UGC campus address names a Rajshahi-Division district, or, when UGC gives no address at all, where the university's name does (flagged in notes). Officials' names (VC, registrar etc.) are dropped. Phones: only landline/hotline numbers kept (mobile numbers dropped as possibly personal); e-mails: only the university's own domain or institutional-looking addresses. No coordinates. Licence not stated.
